title: 2364. Count Number of Bad Pairs

examples.explanation: The pair (0, 1) is a bad pair since 1 - 0 != 1 - 4. The pair (0, 2) is a bad pair since 2 - 0 != 3 - 4, 2 != -1. The pair (0, 3) is a bad pair since 3 - 0 != 3 - 4, 3 != -1. The pair (1, 2) is a bad pair since 2 - 1 != 3 - 1, 1 != 2. The pair (2, 3) is a bad pair since 3 - 2 != 3 - 3, 1 != 0. There are a total of 5 bad pairs, so we return 5.
